result.topic_en: Draft notes on determining a function u on a multi-sheeted surface from its boundary values, with a computation showing that the integral of du/dp along the whole boundary equals -2π times the sum of the orders (n-1) of the branch points.

methods.what: Local behaviour near a branch point of order n-1: log(du/dz) minus (n-1)log(z-z') is finite; polar coordinates around the point
Integral of normal derivative around a small circle about a branch point
Total boundary integral of du/dp equals -2π times sum of branch-point orders
Reduction of boundary integral to small curves around branch points

items.quote: Offenbar können diese Bestimmungen auch auf Linien im Innern von T verwandt werden.
items.english: Obviously these determinations can also be applied to lines in the interior of T.

items.quote:
Es [-wird-] ist daher $\int \frac{\partial u}{\partial p}\, ds$
durch die ganze Begrenzung von T ausgedehnt $= -2\pi\sum(n-1)$
items.english: Hence the integral of du/dp ds extended over the whole boundary of T equals -2π Σ(n-1).
